title: Salsa step
excerpt: The salsa step in house dance is a groovy forward-and-back foot pattern built on the signature house bounce. The dancer keeps a steady, relaxed rhythm, letting the knees soften and the body pulse gently with the beat.

title: House bounce
excerpt: The house bounce is a small, continuous pulse through the knees and hips. Everything else in house sits on top of it.

title: Breaking freeze
excerpt: A freeze stops the body on the beat in a controlled pose. Strength and lines matter more than how long you can hold it.
reason: Needs a clearer description of how weight sits in the freeze, and a note on musicality.
